content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on IBM. Purchases are purely order-driven — Section 6.0 makes IBM's purchase obligation subject to the agreement's terms with no requirements commitment, and Section 6.1 permits IBM to cancel any and all Purchase Orders at any time. The only "exclusive" references are an entire-agreement clause and MSL's exclusive remedy under the loan agreement; the "solely" restrictions run against MSL (use of IBM Parts and purchased assets in IBM Products only), which benefits us. No redline proposed.
